subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` plus a shared command-queue `onTaskTimeout` hook as the compatibility boundary for bounding deferred context-engine maintenance?
rationale: The code path is plausible and covered, but adding an operator config key and shared queue callback establishes product/API surface that automation should not bless without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept opt-in timeout contract
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers are comfortable with a default-disabled config key and shared timeout hook for this session-state repair.

options.title: Reuse existing compaction timeout policy
options.body: Ask the branch to remove the new key and derive the maintenance bound from the existing compaction timeout budget if maintainers want fewer config surfaces.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want burst coalescing or shorter interactive recovery thresholds solved in the same product decision.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in timeout contract
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers are comfortable with a default-disabled config key and shared timeout hook for this session-state repair.
